attackers_goals: Adversaries may delete data to prevent the recovery of a corrupted system. They may also aim to interrupt availability to resources.
description: An identity deleted multiple S3 object versions at a high frequency, considerably more than usual. This may indicate an attempt to permanently purge historical versions to prevent data recovery, common in ransomware or malicious data destruction attacks.
investigative_actions: Identify the deleted objects and their containing bucket. Investigate the identity performed the deletion and recent related activity.
name: Mass deletion of versioned S3 objects
